verdict.rationale: Clerk documents support for both Client ID Metadata Documents and Dynamic Client Registration, the MCP-spec client registration methods (clerk-docs-57). Its changelog announces custom OAuth scopes that give MCP clients precise, discoverable access (clerk-docs-55), and its OAuth implementation supports scoped access (clerk-docs-44). Tokens are JWTs that the backend can verify (clerk-docs-62). Missing for 10: an explicit guide for protecting your own MCP server (protected-resource metadata, token verification middleware), clarity that clerk-docs-57 covers customer MCP servers and not only Clerk's own MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
